comment: Declarative registry of built-in MCP integrations. scripts/bootstrap-integrations.cjs turns this into the DSH patch overlay at container start.

integrations.description: Read-only Gmail: search, read threads, list labels, download one attachment. Never sends mail.

Universal read-only+organise IMAP mail for four accounts (Gmail XOAUTH2, two Yandex, Mail.ru). Search, read, list folders/labels, conversations, and previewed/approved organising actions (flags, archive, move, labels, trash). Never sends, drafts, or permanently deletes.
